scientific_integrity: The finite moment identities, marked factorial-moment proof, and explicit payoff-retention integrals are supplied with a standalone exact-check script. Finite verification does not certify infinite convergence; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Both game action dimensions must diverge. Atomless independent player payoff tables with coordinatewise independent retention/replacement; the coupled-choice general theorem additionally requires independent and uniformly relabeling-invariant paired choices. No fixed-dimensional, tied-payoff, additive-noise, or within-game correlated-payoff conclusion is claimed. Historical priority against unlocated coupled-mapping generalizations cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact agreement factorization and marked Poisson persistence of random best-response equilibria
